shortDescription: Greece sold 500 million euros ($578.65 million) of 52-weeks T-bills at a higher yield compared to the previous auction, its debt agency PDMA said on Wednesday.The yield came in at 2.62%, up from 2.41% in June.($1 = 0.8641 euros)

children: Greece sold 500 million euros ($578.65 million) of 52-weeks T-bills at a higher yield compared to the previous auction, its debt agency PDMA said on Wednesday.
The yield came in at 2.62%, up from 2.41% in June.
